question: List Non-Small Cell Lung Nivolumab, Ipilimumab trials where overall follow‑up exceeded 21 months.

gemini.answer: This query selects NSCLC trials using Nivolumab and Ipilimumab with an overall follow-up duration exceeding 21 months, returning the nct, author, year, and pubmed_id.
gemini.raw:
```json
{
  "sql": "SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"pubmed_id\" FROM public.\"clinical_trials\" WHERE \"cancer_type\" ILIKE '%NSCLC%' AND \"ici_name\" ILIKE '%Nivolumab%' AND \"ici_name\" ILIKE '%Ipilimumab%' AND \"follow_up_duration_overall_months\" > 21",
  "answer": "This query selects NSCLC trials using Nivolumab and Ipilimumab with an overall follow-up duration exceeding 21 months, returning the nct, author, year, and pubmed_id.",
  "assumptions": ""
}
```
